author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: legs up behind, body bending down, arms plunging into a three-trough wave line, round head beside the shoulders; matches the reference's diving pose. The rejected drawing had a small head with a dot and a flat, lumpy water line. Human spacing: head r5 at (36,21); the neck ends at (23,21) with a horizontal tangent, so the head outline is exactly 8 from it on centerlines (4 units of visible ink), and the checker certifies it. The arms, which leave the shoulder at (20,21), pass 8.8 or more from the head.
omissions: The reference's diagonal neck is drawn with a short horizontal neck (a diagonal head gap cannot be certified); the reference's outlined limb shape is drawn as single strokes (stick figure).
drawing_plan: SQUARE: waves are half-ellipses rx6 ry4 between cusps x 6/18/30/42 at y 38; body (8,6)-(13,16)-(20,21)-(23,21); arms (20,21)-(30,38) into the cusp; head r5 at (36,21).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'waves' for the water; no Lucide diver exists. Human reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/full_body_ref.png.
